# ContactField

One field for an email or a mobile number. Start typing digits and a country flag slides in. Leave the field with a mistyped domain such as `gmial.com` and the fix is offered underneath; clicking it applies it.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/blocks/contactfield)

## Usage

```tsx
<ContactField
  value={contact}
  onChange={setContact}
  error={error}
  onBlur={() => setError(contactError(contact, false))}
  flag="🇺🇸"
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `value / onChange` | `string / (value) => void` | What was typed. |
| `error` | `string \| null` | Message under the field. |
| `onBlur` | `() => void` | Runs before the typo check. Validate here. |
| `flag` | `string` | Emoji shown once a phone number is being typed. |
| `typos` | `Record<string, string>` | Domain typos and corrections. Defaults to a short built-in list. |
